The first is a street tee with a male thread on one of its three ports so it screws straight into a fitting, with a male NPT end, a female NPT end and a female NPT end; the second is a three-port tee that splits or combines a line, with three female NPT ends. Choose by the line layout: this listing has 9 part numbers, 1/8" to 2".
